size.label: Size
size.description: How many 60+ residents and how fast the pool is growing

affordability.label: Affordability
affordability.description: Income, wealth composition and housing equity of 65+ households

need.label: Need
need.description: Life-stage signals: spouse present, mortgage still on the home

reachability.label: Reachability
reachability.description: Whether the pool can be reached efficiently through any channel

whitespace.label: Whitespace
whitespace.description: Insurance agency density per 1,000 residents aged 60+, inverted

insurability.label: Insurability
insurability.description: Area-level chronic-condition burden (adults 18+); not individual eligibility

volume.label: Volume
volume.description: Biggest 60+ pools - where the most potential customers live

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Equal-footing trade-off across all six sub-scores

final_expense.label: Final Expense / Guaranteed Issue
final_expense.description: Deep need + ability to pay; higher area disease burden is neutral-to-positive (no underwriting)

legacy_wealth.label: Legacy / Wealth
legacy_wealth.description: Affluent 65+ households with capacity for permanent life and estate planning

spouse_protection.label: Spouse / Mortgage Protection
spouse_protection.description: Couples with dependents and remaining housing obligations

metrics.label: Residents aged 60+
metrics.description: How many people aged 60 or over live here. The core measure of market size.

metrics.label: Share of residents aged 60+
metrics.description: What share of the local population is 60 or older. High shares signal an older, retirement-heavy market.

metrics.label: Growth of 60+ population, 2020 to 2025
metrics.description: How fast the 60+ population grew between 2020 and 2025. Growth means the market is getting bigger.

metrics.label: Median household income, householder 65+
metrics.description: The typical income of households led by someone 65 or older. Higher income means more ability to pay a premium.

metrics.label: Share of 65+ households with income $75k+
metrics.description: The share of 65+ households earning $75,000 or more. A direct read on how many can afford a meaningful policy.

metrics.label: Interest, dividend, IRA and pension income per tax return
metrics.description: Interest, dividends, IRA and pension income reported per tax return. A sign of retirement income and accumulated assets.

metrics.label: Dividends, interest and rent per resident
metrics.description: Dividends, interest and rent per resident. A wealth-composition signal for the area.

metrics.label: Housing equity proxy for 65+ owners (mortgage-free value)
metrics.description: A proxy for how much housing wealth 65+ owners hold outright. Home equity is often the asset that funds a policy.

metrics.label: Share of 65+ adults in a household with a spouse present
metrics.description: The share of 65+ adults living with a spouse. Couples are the core market for spouse and survivor protection.

metrics.label: Share of 65+ owners still paying a mortgage
metrics.description: The share of 65+ homeowners still paying a mortgage. A remaining mortgage is a concrete reason to keep coverage.

metrics.label: Share of 65+ residents receiving Social Security benefits
metrics.description: The share of 65+ residents receiving Social Security. A high share means income is a fixed benefit that is hard to replace, which raises the need for a guaranteed death benefit.

metrics.label: Share of 65+ households with internet subscription
metrics.description: The share of 65+ households with an internet subscription. A proxy for how easily this market can be reached online.

metrics.label: Residents aged 60+ per square mile
metrics.description: Residents aged 60+ per square mile. Dense markets are cheaper to cover with field agents, events and local media.

metrics.label: Insurance agencies per 1,000 residents aged 60+
metrics.description: Insurance agencies per 1,000 residents aged 60+. Fewer agencies means less competition for the same customers.

metrics.label: Chronic-condition burden index (adults 18+)
metrics.description: A standardised index of chronic-condition prevalence for adults 18+. Area context only; it is not an individual eligibility test.

metrics.label: Risk-behaviour burden index (adults 18+)
metrics.description: A standardised index of modifiable health-risk behaviours for adults 18+. Area context only, never a decision about a person.

metrics.label: Expected life-insurance ownership among 65+ households
metrics.description: A modelled estimate of how many 65+ households already own life insurance, based on national survey rates applied to local incomes. A prior, not an observation.

metrics.label: Estimated uninsured households with a 65+ householder
metrics.description: A modelled estimate of 65+ households without life insurance. The size of the uninsured opportunity, not a count of buyers.

metrics.label: Area health context: poor physical or mental health (adults 18+)
metrics.description: The share of adults reporting poor physical or mental health. Shown for context only and never used in scoring.
